subject: Let's meet and catch up
body:
Hi Magda and Giulia,

Hope all is well.

I sent this email to you from my other email address and I think it fell through the cracks. I'll be in the UK in the first two weeks of October and wanted to check if you are available to meet and catch up. It's been a while since we've started working together remotely and I thought it'd be a great opportunity to get to know each other better and to discuss the work ahead. We can meet at your office or over a coffee/dinner.

Please let me know if you are down for this and I'll arrange my time based on your availability.

Looking forward to it.
Best,
Amin
VP, Solutions & Innovation

Giulia
